title: Soft Glam vs. Full Glam: Which Bridal Look Is Right for You?
excerpt: Choosing between soft glam and full glam can feel overwhelming, but understanding each style makes the decision effortless.
content: Soft glam embraces luminous skin, neutral tones, and feathery lashes for a timeless, editorial feel that photographs beautifully in natural Florida light. Full glam, by contrast, delivers bold liner, intense contour, and dramatic lashes that command attention from the ceremony to the reception. Your venue, lighting, and personal style are the ultimate guides — and a professional bridal trial is the perfect place to explore both before your big day.
